text.tspan: A cartographer returns to a city that has erased every street she
remembers—and finds one stranger still living inside her old map.
and endings that refuse to explain themselves.
Mara, a mapmaker living in exile, returns home after the monsoon to find an impossible city:
entire neighborhoods have vanished from public memory. Only a night watchman recognizes her map.
Together they trace the last surviving street before the rain comes again.
